newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL PILE ON MAMMOTH 309-8 VS MASHONALAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL PILE ON MAMMOTH 309-8 VS MASHONALAND.

text.p: and Jonty Rhodes (85) put Mashonaland's attack to the sword as
the home side made a mammoth 309 for eight in their Standard
Bank Cup semi-final at Kingsmead on Friday.
The pair plundered 142 for the fourth wicket in only 20
overs to help Natal to the highest domestic one-day total ever
Natal made 307 for three against Impalas at Kingsmead during
Rhodes, electrifyingly quick between the wickets, made his
85 from only 68 balls with eight fours and two sixes before
being caught behind off the leg-spin of Brian Murphy.
Earlier Natal got off to a flying start, helped by a wayward
opening spell from Everton Matambanadzo which saw 37 runs taken
Andrew Hudson (10) and Lance Klusener (36) hammered 44 for
the first wicket in only six overs and, although Hudson and
Klusener were both back in the pavilion before the end of the
ninth over, the run-rate was maintained by the rest of the top
All-rounder Derek Crookes struck 30 from just 25 balls
before holing out to deep mid wicket to pave the way for the
dominant partnership between Johnson and Rhodes.
Left-arm seamer Bryan Strang was the outstanding figure in a
wilting Mashonaland attack with an impressive return of
